name: Laboratory Slide-Wire Rheostat (Variable Resistor)
semanticDescription: Laboratory-grade sliding rheostat / variable resistor for controlling current and regulating voltage in electrical circuits (NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 11 Electricity, Activity 11.2 and Figures 11.2 & 11.3). Features dual presentation collections: Rheostat_Full (heavy cast-iron end upright brackets, porcelain ceramic insulating cylinder, tightly wound constantan resistance wire coil with polished upper slider track, brass slider guide bar, spring contact rider with phenolic handle knob, and three knurled brass binding posts on studio slate plinth) and Rheostat_Section (annotated electro-mechanical view displaying active conductor path between Terminal A and Slider C, effective length l dimension caliper, and educational plaque on brass stanchions).
simplifications: Wire turns represented as discrete close-pitch rings for optimal real-time rendering.
Internal ceramic tube hollow thickness simplified to solid cylinder core.

materials.look: Matte black enameled cast-iron end support brackets
Machined brass slider rod and terminal binding posts
Luminescent cyan active conductor path and current flow vectors
Dark studio slate display pedestal with satin gold trim
